title: block
description: One block in full, from describe: where it is, the file as written and the block as read, so a reader can show the block or the file it comes from.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Block, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: The block: its kind, id, file, the file's text and the block as read.

kind.description: Always Block. describe answers for any kind of resource, so data says which kind it describes.

id.description: The block's id. An id is unique only within a kind, so kind and id together name the block.

path.description: The file, relative to the design, so a reader can open it or point to it.

text.description: The file as written, comments and all, for a reader that shows the file itself rather than the block as read.

document.description: The block as read from its file, the same shape get blocks gives for each block.
One Block resource as a design's file holds it. get blocks and describe share it, so a block reads the same in both.

apiVersion.description: Always core/design/v2, the form a design's files are written in at this contract (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml). A reader that meets another form knows the file is not one this contract reads (ADR-S16).

kind.description: Always Block, the kind of resource.

metadata.description: What names the block, apart from what it says.

id.description: The block's id, unique among the design's Blocks. Links and other resources point to the block by it.

title.description: The block's name for people, shown on its card on the board.

tags.description: Labels the design's user puts on the block.

spec.description: What the block says. Written by the design's user, so it stays open: a design's fields are its own (CT-RULE-4).
